info.title: Tunnel_Endpoint
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

destination.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
Destination tunnel IP address in IPv4 or IPv6 format.

interface.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
Interface that tunnel endpoint is associated with.

macs_invalid.description: If `true`, indicates that MACs on this vtep are invalid.

network_id.description:
Reference Resource: [Virtual_Network_ID](#/Virtual_Network_ID)
Network ID (VNI in VXLAN case) that should be used to reach this endpoint.

origin.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
Identifies the mechanism that is responsible for the creation of the endpoint: 'static': user configuration 'evpn': dynamically learnt via EVPN 'hsc': dynamically learnt from a remote controller(e.g.NSX)

state.description: Status of this tunnel endpoint: 'operational':         endpoint is fully provisioned in the forwarding path 'configuration_error': endpoint provisioning failed due to misconfiguration 'no_hw_resources':     endpoint provisioning failed due to insufficient resources 'activating':          endpoint is being provisioned

rx_bum_bytes.description: Total number of broadcast, unknown-unicast and multicast (BUM)  bytes received on the VTEP across all VNIs.

rx_bum_packets.description: Total number of broadcast, unknown-unicast and multicast (BUM)  packets received on the VTEP across all VNIs.

rx_bytes.description: Total number of bytes received on the VTEP across all VNIs.

rx_packets.description: Total number of packets received on the VTEP across all VNIs.

tx_bum_bytes.description: Total number of broadcast, unknown-unicast and multicast (BUM)  bytes transmitted to the VTEP across all VNIs.

tx_bum_packets.description: Total number of broadcast, unknown-unicast and multicast (BUM)  packets transmitted to the VTEP across all VNIs.

tx_bytes.description: Total number of bytes transmitted to the VTEP across all VNIs.

tx_packets.description: Total number of packets transmitted to the VTEP across all VNIs.

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [Tunnel_Endpoint](#/Tunnel_Endpoint)
VRF to be used for resolving the destination address.

parameters.name: Interface.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [Interface](#/Interface)
The interface name. For non-bonded ports, the interface name is the same as the associated port name. The name must otherwise be unique across all ports and interfaces of the system.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
